protected_periods.2025H1: locked until all 2023/2024 gates and Research/MT4 parity pass

global_execution_contract.execution_time: first available tick at the next protocol execution bar open
global_execution_contract.entry_price: Ask for long and Bid for short
global_execution_contract.exit_price: Bid for long and Ask for short
global_execution_contract.default_cost: observed variable Bid/Ask spread with minimum 0.5 pip where accepted baseline uses the historical floor
global_execution_contract.severe_cost: three times the default spread plus 1.0 pip
global_execution_contract.commission_and_swap: retain accepted baseline treatment and report separately when nonzero
global_execution_contract.liquidation_boundary: close at final available executable quote and flag boundary_liquidation; event-only metrics exclude it
global_execution_contract.missing_bar_rule: no interpolation; a required incomplete bar cancels that transition observation
global_execution_contract.same_timestamp_rule: existing baseline exit first, then candidate exit, then new baseline entry; one action per ticket per timestamp
global_execution_contract.duplicate_signal_rule: same ticket and same candidate transition may trigger once only
global_execution_contract.stack_rule: evaluate every baseline ticket independently while retaining exposure-state labels; candidate exit does not suppress other baseline signals
global_execution_contract.threshold_selection: no medians, AUC optima, pip loss checkpoints, oscillator levels or post-result repairs

duplicate_audit.Family_A: not an M15 wick/outside entry threshold; observation begins after executable baseline entry and requires completed M5 transition
duplicate_audit.Family_C: giveback trigger does not use MFE20 or return inside the original breakout level
duplicate_audit.Family_E: does not use exposure-state routing or 60/90-minute recovery windows
duplicate_audit.Family_F: does not require a second B02/F05 signal
duplicate_audit.Family_G_H: does not use breakout-level reacceptance as the termination trigger
duplicate_audit.Family_I: not a static four-hour admission filter
duplicate_audit.RQ_016: does not subdivide a post-invalidation P/L trajectory
duplicate_audit.RQ_020E_RQ_021: not an unconditional fixed-horizon cell; observation times establish when completed structures can be read, while the action requires an event transition
duplicate_audit.HYP_023: not a primary native H4/H1 strategy; this is a lifecycle overlay on accepted B02/F05 baseline tickets using M5/M15/M30 structure
duplicate_audit.novelty: separate setup, establishment, continuation and decay states on the same accepted baseline ticket

state_components: direction-aligned aggregate body from entry is strictly positive
latest completed M5 close remains on the breakout side of the frozen baseline breakout level
candidates.transition: PENDING -> ESTABLISHED when both components hold; otherwise PENDING -> FAILED
candidates.action: FAILED exits at next M1 open; ESTABLISHED remains under baseline management
candidates.rejection: reject if any fold fails P3 count and gross-loss-share improvement or right-tail gates

state_components: latest completed M5 close remains on breakout side
at least one completed M1 favorable extreme update occurred after entry
last completed M1 close is not adverse to the entry-side aggregate open
candidates.transition: PENDING -> ESTABLISHED only when all components hold; otherwise FAILED
candidates.action: FAILED exits at next M1 open

candidates.eligibility: ticket previously reached ESTABLISHED under L1_RETENTION_BODY
state_components: latest completed M15 close remains on breakout side
latest completed M15 made a favorable extreme beyond the preceding completed M15
candidates.transition: ESTABLISHED -> CONTINUING if all components hold; otherwise CONTINUATION_FAILED
candidates.action: CONTINUATION_FAILED exits at next M1 open

candidates.eligibility: ticket previously reached ESTABLISHED under L1_RETENTION_BODY
state_components: latest completed M15 close remains on breakout side
latest completed M15 true range is greater than the immediately preceding completed M15 true range
latest favorable extreme is not lower than the prior favorable extreme
candidates.transition: ESTABLISHED -> CONTINUING if all components hold; otherwise CONTINUATION_FAILED
candidates.action: CONTINUATION_FAILED exits at next M1 open

candidates.observation_start: after first executable +10-pip path-class landmark; the landmark arms observation but is never an exit trigger
state_components: PEAKED after a completed M30 favorable extreme update following observation start
STALLED after a later completed M30 fails to update the favorable extreme
REVERSED when the next completed M30 has adverse directional body and closes beyond the adverse extreme of the STALLED bar
candidates.action: REVERSED exits at next M1 open
candidates.anti_trailing_stop: no fixed distance from peak, entry or current P/L is used

state_components: PEAKED after a completed favorable M30 extreme update
DECAY_1 when a completed M30 makes no favorable extreme update and has nonpositive directional body
DECAY_2 when the next completed M30 again makes no favorable extreme update and closes adverse to DECAY_1 close
candidates.action: DECAY_2 exits at next M1 open
candidates.anti_trailing_stop: event sequence only; no distance threshold

L1: P3 count lower in every fold for B02 and F05 separately
P3 gross-loss share lower in every fold
winner and P1 removal reported and winner right tail retained
long and short both represented without exceptions
L2: P2 gross loss improves in every fold per strategy
net effect includes premature winner and P1 exits and remains positive
winner top 10 percent and top 5 percent tails retained
L3: P1 giveback loss improves in every fold per strategy
winner top 10 percent and top 5 percent tails retained
next-bar execution remains positive under severe cost
not equivalent to fixed trailing stop or breakout reacceptance
common: half-year, month, best-one/date and best-two/date removal

post_result_rule: No threshold, observation time, component or gate repair after outcomes. Failed candidates close unchanged.
